record.question: Under Section 3 of the Arms Act, 1959, which of the following statements is correct regarding the acquisition and possession of firearms?
options: Any adult citizen of India can freely possess a firearm without a licence
A person must obtain a valid licence to acquire, possess, or carry any firearm orammunition
Firearms may be acquired only for sporting purposes, and no licence is required
Only police officers are permitted to possess firearms under any circumstance
record.explanation: Unauthorized possession of prohibited arms carries minimum seven years up to life.
